name: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
summary: Daily astronomy image or video with a title and an explanation written by a professional astronomer.
description: The APOD API returns the picture of the day for any date since 1995, with title, explanation, media type and image URLs. Date ranges and random samples are supported.

rate_limit.summary: 1,000 requests per hour per key; DEMO_KEY: 30 per hour

endpoints.summary: Picture of the day for a date or date range

license.name: Public domain (mostly; some images are copyrighted)

caveats: Some images carry third-party copyright; check the copyright field.
